# State machine tables

Each machine with a table in the code has it here, generated from that table, so
this page cannot drift from what the code does. [State machines](state-machines.md)
says what each promises. Each row is one event in one state, and a refused one says
why.

### A transaction

`src/effect/database.ts`

| State | Event | Moves to | Mark |
|---|---|---|---|
| Open | `StatementFailed` | Poisoned | ok |
| Open | `Finish` | Open | ignored: nothing failed, so it commits |
| Poisoned | `StatementFailed` | Poisoned | ignored: the first failure is the one to report |
| Poisoned | `Finish` | Poisoned | ok |

### Purges a piece of work owes

`src/effect/response-cache.ts`

| State | Event | Moves to | Mark |
|---|---|---|---|
| Open | `Add` | Open | ok |
| Open | `Take` | Taken | ok |
| Taken | `Add` | Taken | refused: The work it belongs to has finished, so nothing would purge it. Give work that outlives its action to background(). |
| Taken | `Take` | Taken | refused: A piece of work's purges are taken once, when it has succeeded. |

### Tags a stored response carries

`src/effect/response-cache.ts`

| State | Event | Moves to | Mark |
|---|---|---|---|
| Open | `Add` | Open | ok |
| Open | `Take` | Taken | ok |
| Taken | `Add` | Taken | refused: Its route has stored the response, so it would tag nothing. Tag the response in the action, before it answers. |
| Taken | `Take` | Taken | refused: A response's cache tags are taken once, when its route stores it. |
